title: Approval rules
description: A rule file as ParseApprovalRules reads it. Among matching rules deny wins; allow exempts from ask but never from deny.

rule.description: One rule. Rules on free-text fields (SQL, shell) are not a security boundary: the same intent always has another spelling.

id.description: Unique within one rule set; the schema cannot check uniqueness, the parser does.

tool.description: Exact name or whole-string glob; * matches every tool.

when.description: Keys are dot-separated input paths: a number segment indexes an array, * matches any element. Every condition must hold.

condition.description: Exactly one operator; normalize only qualifies prefix.

eq.description: JSON equality: numbers compare by value, objects ignore key order.

regex.description: Whole-string match in the portable subset: ASCII \d \w \s \b, quantifiers, (?:), |. Inline flags, ^, $, backreferences and lookaround are rejected.

normalize.description: Clean the field value and the prefix with POSIX path rules and compare whole segments; a relative value never matches an absolute prefix, except a value starting with .. in a deny rule (runtime.md 11).
